title: Staying Healthy
seo_title: Year 2 Science: Staying Healthy Worksheets (Exercise, Food and Hygiene)
standard_text: Describe the importance for humans of exercise, eating the right amounts of different types of food, and hygiene.
meta_desc: Free Year 2 science worksheets on staying healthy: healthy food choices, exercise and what it does to the heart, and washing hands to remove germs. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Eat the right amounts of different foods, move every day and wash away germs.
body_html:
How to think about it

Exercise, healthy food and clean hands.

  • Eat lots of fruit and vegetables; treats only sometimes.
  • Move your body for about an hour a day.
  • Wash your hands with soap to remove germs.
Example

Apple or doughnut?

Fruit is healthy

Answer: an apple

Example

When should you wash your hands?

Germs and food

Answer: before eating

Common mistakes

  • Thinking healthy means never eating any treats.
  • Thinking sitting still is exercise.
  • Thinking you only wash hands when they look dirty.

faq.a: Eat the right amounts of different foods, with plenty of fruit and vegetables, exercise every day, sleep well and keep clean.

faq.q: What does exercise do to my body?
faq.a: It makes your heart beat faster and your breathing quicker. Over time it makes your heart, lungs and muscles stronger.

faq.q: Why do we wash our hands?
faq.a: Hands can carry germs that are too small to see. Washing with soap for about 20 seconds removes them.
